en.hook: Why RAG Is a Data Engineering Problem (And How to Build Production Retrieval Pipelines)
en.body: Most RAG failures are data pipeline failures. Learn how to build production retrieval pipelines with pgvector, hybrid search, and citation validation that actually work at scale.
en.cta: Read the full story on the site and use GitHub as the operational proof point.
